_comment: Fail-closed motion envelope for the web panel. Angles in DEGREES. The window is intersected with the URDF limits at load time: the narrower bound always wins. Preset poses are clipped into the window; a preset that needs a wider window is a preset to fix, not a window to widen.

door.desc: view toward the door (left of home)
